name: Ammunition Canister [1]
summary: Ammunition Canister [1] is a deployable ammo box tool available from the starter loadout.
role: Use it when a hold is going to last longer than your carried ammo. Activating the canister places a universal ammo box and consumes the tool.
fun_facts: Both ammunition canister variants deploy the same universal ammo box.

name: Ammunition Canister [2]
summary: Ammunition Canister [2] is the shop-side ammo canister variant that deploys a universal ammo box.
role: Bring it for long capture holds, boss preparation, or any defense where the team is likely to run dry before the wave pressure stops.
fun_facts: The canister drops ammo exactly where you deploy it, so placement matters during a hold.

name: RallyDrop
summary: RallyDrop is the vehicle call-in tool used to spawn player-owned transports, armor, and aircraft near the player.
role: Use RallyDrop to move squads, bring vehicle weapons to a fight, or recover distance after a lost spawn. Free access covers the LTV-300; broader vehicle access comes from RallyDrop ownership and the WWII vehicle pass.
fun_facts: RallyDrop checks multiple spawn rings around the player, from 26 to 90 studs.
Available paint colors are Coyote, Green, Tan, and Grey.
